# Matthew Mulenga

> Software engineer in Saskatoon, SK (remote-first). Six years of production ownership at the
> University of Saskatchewan, moving from university systems into industry. Mid-to-senior
> backend/full-stack engineer, not a career changer.

## Summary

- Currently: Programmer, University of Saskatchewan — October 2019 to present.
- Education: B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Saskatchewan, 2019.
- Strongest in: Java, Spring Boot, Groovy/Grails, Oracle SQL, REST API design, Python.
- Also worked with: Rust, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Bash, Git, Docker, AWS.
- Looking for: mid-to-senior backend or full-stack roles on teams building integrations,
  platform services, or data infrastructure.
- Location: Saskatoon, SK (Central Time). Six years fully remote; open to hybrid in Saskatoon.
- Contact: matt.mulengawoo@gmail.com

## Featured work

- **Credential network integration** — built and owns the API integration between the
  University's student information system and Canada's national credential network, covering
  the full document lifecycle (request, generation, signing, delivery). Unlocked $200K+ in
  annual revenue and remains the delivery path for every credential the University issues.
- **Identity data pipeline** — replaced a brittle legacy replication process with an API-driven
  pipeline syncing identity data for 30,000+ students, faculty and staff.
- **Graduate progress tracker** — built solo from an empty repository; used university-wide by
  graduate committees to replace paper/email tracking.
- **Confirmation of Graduation system** — took over an unowned application and rewrote its
  document generation, including patching an embedded PDF library to support required features.
- Owns three enterprise systems outright: document management, academic advising, and degree
  audit. Mentored two developers and wrote documentation that didn't previously exist.
